page.overview:
Who is Corso?

Corso was an Italian Regional Counsellor (officially called the President) responsible for the area of land where Biosyn Valley is located.

While meeting with Soyona Santos, Lewis Dodgson asks to borrow the Handler and her Atrociraptor pack to kill Corso because the counsellor is holding up the special land permit that Dodgson needs for Biosyn Valley. Dodgson insists that all else has failed so killing him is the only option. However, Santos wants to try the same intimidation tactic that they had used on Chuck Desai and Dodgson seemingly concedes.

Shortly thereafter, Santos and Brooklynn see a news report revealing that Corso was killed in a dinosaur attack. The furious Santos realizes that Dodgson went behind her back and used the Handler and her Atrociraptor pack to kill Corso.
